strategy: Port specialization, rebuilt on F's own one-ply mechanism: for every legal action, execute a real copy of the game (game.copy().execute(action), the same call ValueFunctionPlayer.decide() makes) and score the RESULTING state with catanatron.players.value.base_fn(DEFAULT_WEIGHTS) -- the exact function/weights F runs. B04's identity (port conversion) is an additive bonus on top, scaled below base_fn's production weight (1e8) so it only breaks near-ties base_fn already found close: a bonus for BUILD_SETTLEMENT/BUILD_ROAD actions that land on or route toward a port node whose matching resource my own simulated resultant production (catanatron.features.build_production_features, read from the real post-action state, not a static lookup) actually justifies; withdrawn once the opponent reaches PORT_URGENCY_CUTOFF=9 public VP.
